Future City Animations - Bryce

Andy CASA, UCL East

We are suckers for a good future city animation and can sometimes be found trawling the depths of YouTube for the best examples (is it just us?).

As such we thought it would be worthwhile to make a new series of posts looking at architectural animations of the future city and up first is a simple yet effective example made with Bryce 5:



Created and uploaded by a YouTube user going by the name of Moht1 the movie is the result of his first creation using Bryce 5 and as such it shows the potential of the Bryce which is now up to version 6.0.

The movie below provides an insight into the quality of output possible with Bryce 6:
